review.instruction: Review the selected artifact against the request and the base branch of the pull request identified by run_input in github_repository. Inspect the full diff and run relevant deterministic tests. Leave files unchanged. Set approved=true only when no concrete findings remain; otherwise return actionable findings. Do not push, merge, or post comments.

approved.description: True only when no blocking review findings remain.

findings.description: Blocking problems that must be fixed before approval.

fix.instruction: Fix the concrete findings in inputs[0].data.findings in the assigned worktree. Run relevant deterministic tests and summarize fixes. Leave final files for the runtime checkpoint. Do not push, merge, or post comments.

push.instruction: Commit any uncommitted changes in the worktree, then update the head branch of the pull request identified by run_input in github_repository with this worktree's HEAD, following repository conventions. Do not force-overwrite changes made by others. Do not merge or post comments. Report the resulting PR head SHA.

merge.instruction: Merge the pull request identified by run_input in github_repository, following repository conventions and GitHub policy. Do not bypass required checks or reviews. Report whether it merged and the merge commit.

merge_commit.description: Merge commit SHA; omit when not merged.
